svg.title: Seal and maintain the hydrothermal treatment
svg.desc: Seal the system and treat at 150 °C for 10 h. The autoclave construction, gas composition, pressure and heating ramp are not supplied. Phase-transfer and reduction statements are source-proposed interpretation, not additional independently controlled steps. Conceptual geometry; no measured apparatus design.
